title: Hyatt Breathless Puerto Vallarta announcement with GSF
text: Breathless Puerto Vallarta Resort & Spa is set to open in 2025 as part of the Inclusive Collection. Desarrollado por Hyatt y Grupo Hotelero Santa Fe, Breathless Puerto Vallarta Resort & Spa tendrá más de 450 lujosas suites. The announcement does not state that Breathless is the current operating brand of Krystal Grand Puerto Vallarta.
